items.claim: [r42-1] pointSnap's trail snapped with free modifiers, so the cursor preview didn't match the click
items.note: `<SceneCanvas>` now sources a new `modifiers` dep (`HeldModifiersDep`). `PointSnap.trail` takes `SnapMods`, which is a breaking change with a `major` changeset. `createPointerFollower` can follow modifier changes too. The pen and spiro previews both snap under the held keys. There is a new pen test; spiro got the same fix but no test of its own.

items.claim: [r42-2] SnapCollect.include was documented and read but never set
items.note: This was a behavior call: I removed the field and its use in `pathSnapSource`, and did not plumb it through `SnapBegin`. Only one source read it, and it would only work if every source honored it, as they all do for `exclude`. The call is recorded in `docs/unruled.md`. It is breaking, with a `major` changeset.
It now takes `along` and `omit`. Its own `sources` already serve as the gesture's sources.

items.claim: [r42-4] The test sessionDep ignored a request's `sources` and `omit`
items.note: A shared `requestedSnapSources` helper now does this for the canvas dep too. Measure's test dep had the same gap and now asks a request's own `sources` too.

items.claim: [r42-5] The debug overlay placed a segment or bounded-face candidate on its unbounded line or plane
items.note: This uses a new geom export, `nearestOnSpan`, added in bb54e244f8.

items.claim: [r42-6] A group move never found its own geometry, because `geometryAt` got the group's id rather than its subtree
items.note: `ownGeometryAt` now expands each id to its subtree.

items.claim: [r42-7] `SpanSnap.anchor` moved the start but `startHeld()` still reported the old snap
